status: DESIGN v1.0 - numbers tagged in SYSTEM.md (V verified / E estimated / OPEN). Base mass & CoG are estimates from a part-by-part budget.
units: SI (m, kg, s, N, N*m, W, V, Ah)

frames.base: origin on the floor under the footprint centre; +x towards the aisle when docked (dock face = -x side), +y along the counter, z up
frames.world_dock_pose: footprint x -0.02..0.63, y 0.12..0.72 (centre (0.305, 0.42)), yaw 0 -> arm base world (0.48, 0.42, 0.80) yaw 195 deg, exactly as sim M1

arm_choice.why: same kinematics as the simulated Panda (reach 0.855 m); only joint limits differ
arm_choice.power: 100-240 VAC, ~80 W (datasheet); fed by 48 V->230 V inverter

sim_recheck_required.critical: FR3 joint 6 lower limit is +25.2 deg vs Panda -1.0 deg (26 deg tighter); joint 4 upper -6.7 vs -4.0 deg; joint 5 +-164.8 vs +-166 deg. Every path whose Panda margin on q6 (low side) was < ~28 deg must be re-planned. Report min q6 per step.

envelope.note: All equipment fits inside the sim's chassis box + column; nothing above z 0.32 except the column (arm workspace + open door at z 0.91).

base.drive: differential: 2 driven wheels on the y axis through the footprint centre + 4 swivel casters at the corners; driven wheels on sprung arms (carry ~55 % of weight)
base.drive_unit_note: motor+brake+gearhead lie along the axle, inboard of each wheel (about 0.2 m each); battery modules sit fore and aft of the axle
base.motor: Oriental Motor BLMR6200SKM-GFV-F + GFV6G50 gearhead + BLVD-KRD driver (200 W, 24/48 VDC, power-off brake)
base.brake_type: spring-applied, power-off activated, on motor shaft (x50 through gearhead)
base.brake_holding_note: 0.637 N*m motor-shaft brake (verified) x 50; capped by gearhead permissible torque 27.4 N*m (assumption, confirm with Oriental)

docking.method: lidar line-fit on cabinet fronts/plinth -> reverse at 0.05 m/s into 2 floor/plinth-mounted V-blocks (cone pins on the cart rear, z ~0.05), drive pushes 100 N, brakes apply
docking.per_dock_calibration: wall camera sees AprilTag on the hand at 3 poses -> camera-to-robot transform re-estimated each dock (removes base-pose error from perception)

battery.chemistry: LiFePO4 16S (2 x 8S modules in series, one BMS with CAN)

components.tag: V ~80 W datasheet; idle E; peak 450 W reseller (UNVERIFIED)
calc: 46 W mech peak accel, 13 W cruise; 200 W rated each

charger.model: Mean Well NPB-750-48 on the dock

phases.phase: wake: inverter on, FR3 boot + self-test

sim_rechecks_requested: Replace Panda joint limits by FR3 limits (arm_choice.sim_recheck_required); report min q6 and q4 margin per step.

Base pose tolerance: perturb the docked base by +-2 / +-5 mm in x,y and +-0.2 / +-0.5 deg yaw, with perception expressed in the (re-calibrated) robot frame and the dishwasher NOT re-measured; report which steps fail. Design target is <=1 mm / 0.1 deg.
Keep all cart geometry inside the envelope (chassis z<=0.32 + column); add lidar/bumper/e-stop button bumps only inside that box.

Tool stack: Bota SensONE between flange and Franka Hand adds 0.21 kg and its height (~25-30 mm, UNVERIFIED - take from the Bota drawing) to the TCP offset; F/T then sits where the sim's hand_ft site is.
Arm speed: report peak TCP / elbow speed per step; the safety design caps TCP at 0.25 m/s whenever a person may be present (FR3 SLS) - report cycle-time impact.
Drive test: 0.5 m/s, 0.5 m/s^2, 0.8 rad/s yaw, e-stop at 0.5 m/s with brake force limited by tyre friction (mu 0.5 on 55 % of weight) - check no caster lift-off with the arm stowed.

changelog.change: Initial provisional file = simulation's starting numbers + arm=FR3 provisional.

Arm decided FR3 (needs FR3 joint-limit recheck, J6!). Masses from verified parts: base 112.9 kg (was 90), total 132.2 kg, CoG z 0.33 stowed (was 0.35). Battery 51.2 V (16S) 30 Ah. Added envelope + dock preload 100 N. Drive still provisional.

Drive decided: Oriental BLV-R 200 W + power-off brake + 50:1, wheel r 0.10 (was 0.0825), track 0.50, rated 27.4 / peak 55 N*m per wheel (was 15/30), max 80 wheel rpm (0.84 m/s capability, limited to 0.5), brake 27 N*m (was 20). Mass 112.9 kg base / 133.2 kg total, CoG z 0.33. Battery 51.2 V 30 Ah. Added docking, per-component power, energy per cycle, sim rechecks.
